clearedSpotChecks.check: The 512 bit branch of mulDiv by 2^128 in Position.update always ends in SafeCastOverflow at Pool.sol:192 because the fee is then at least 2^128.
clearedSpotChecks.note: FullMath.mulDiv (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:21-38) enters the 512 bit path only when prod1 is nonzero, so a*b is at least 2^256 and the quotient by Q128 (Position.sol:93-96) is at least 2^128. Pool.sol:192 casts feesOwed0 and feesOwed1 with the uint256 toInt128, which reverts for x >= 2^127 (SafeCast.sol:56-58). The branch therefore cannot produce a credit on any network whose MULMOD matches the battery already recorded in OPCODES.md.

clearedSpotChecks.check: The transient slot constants equal keccak256 of their names minus 1 and no line of src/ computes a credit that disagrees with its intent.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I recomputed keccak256 minus 1 for ReservesOf, Currency, Unlocked and NonzeroDeltaCount with tools/opdiff/evm.py and all four match CurrencyReserves.sol:11-13, Lock.sol:8 and NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:9-10. CurrencyDelta._computeSlot (CurrencyDelta.sol:10-16) masks both words to 160 bits before keccak256(0,64), so dirty upper bits cannot alias deltas, and applyDelta (CurrencyDelta.sol:28-40) adds in checked arithmetic.

clearedSpotChecks.check: System contracts at 0x1000 on Polygon and BNB Smart Chain, and the staking precompile at 0x1000 on Monad, explain the pmdiff6 differences; every other record is byte-identical on all 21 networks.
clearedSpotChecks.note: eth_getCode of 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000 returned 14,347 bytes on https://polygon.drpc.org, 29,871 bytes on https://bsc-dataseed1.bnbchain.org and 0 bytes on https://rpc.monad.xyz (precompile, no code), which matches the cleared text. The summary in pmdiff6.json lists identical counts per network as stated (for example Ethereum 703 with differences [277, 279]). 0x1000 is reached only as a currency or recipient the caller names, so the differences affect only the caller's own pool. The equality rests on eth_call, so it does not cover a compiled execution path on Monad or MegaETH; the research file already records that as a lead and I did not resolve it.
